question: Give me all companies in Munich.
sparql: PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/> PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?type wdt:P279* wd:Q4830453 . ?uri wdt:P31 ?type ; wdt:P159 wd:Q1726 . }

question: How many films did Leonardo DiCaprio star in?
sparql: PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/> PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?uri) AS ?c) WHERE { ?uri wdt:P31 wd:Q11424 ; wdt:P161 wd:Q38111 . }

question: Give me all libraries established earlier than 1400.
sparql: PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/> PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> SELECT DISTINCT ?uri WHERE { ?uri wdt:P31 wd:Q7075 ; wdt:P571 ?date . FILTER (YEAR(?date) < 1400 ) }
